project.name: agentbox agents
project.summary: Install AI agent CLIs into this container at runtime. Nothing proprietary is baked into the published image.

briefing.title: Lazy wrappers
briefing.body: You can also just run agent, claude, copilot, grok, gemini, codex, or opencode — each wrapper installs on first use. This wizard is the explicit menu for the same installers.

briefing.title: Why not baked in?
briefing.body: Vendor agent binaries are downloaded by you under each vendor's terms. The Hub image only ships wrappers, installers, and this wizard.

briefing.title: Persistence
briefing.body: Installs land under the container user's home (~/.local, ~/.npm-global). They survive stop/start, but recreate or docker rm wipes them unless you volume-mount that home.
